map.核心关系是 v=ω·r：知道任意两个就能求第三个。换算转速时注意 ω 的单位必须: The core relation is v=ω·r: knowing any two gives the third. When converting rotational speed, note that the unit of ω must be rad/s and that one revolution is 2π radians, so rpm=ω×60/(2π) (multiplying by 60 converts "per second" into "per minute").

map.：ω=v/r=18/3=6.000 rad/s；换算成转速为 ω×60/(2π): : ω=v/r=18/3=6.000 rad/s; converted to rotational speed this is ω×60/(2π)=57.296 rpm. The larger the radius, the lower the angular velocity for the same linear speed.
